# Dyness PowerBrick PRO Balancer

Canonical page: https://elokfu.github.io/cerbo-balancer/
Repository: https://github.com/elokfu/cerbo-balancer

## Summary

Open engineering implementation for three parallel Dyness PowerBrick PRO
batteries on Victron Cerbo GX. It provides read-only 115200 8N1 RS485
telemetry, per-battery balancing control, filtered Cell 16 reconstruction,
capacity-based per-battery SOC, centered dynamic-float voltage, and a persistent
D-Bus guardian at DeviceInstance 101.

## Key facts

- PowerBrick PRO DIP: 00110, Victron and others, 115200 baud.
- Balance entry: spread strictly above 30 mV for eight unique samples.
- Selected pack current target: 2.0 A.
- Dynamic float: four samples before, crossing sample, four samples after.
- Default editable crossing: 3.500 V/cell.
- Guardian fallback: 54.0 V CVL, 20.0 A CCL, 100.0 A DCL.
- RS485 is read-only; Dyness physical protection remains authoritative.

## Documents

- Complete PDF: https://elokfu.github.io/cerbo-balancer/assets/dyness-balancer-algorithm-reference-with-toc.pdf
- Source manual: https://elokfu.github.io/cerbo-balancer/dyness-balancer-implementation.md
- RS485 service: https://elokfu.github.io/cerbo-balancer/rs485-service.md

Normal-mode SOC CCL defaults: 15 A/battery at 97%, 6 A/battery at 98%, and 3 A/battery at >=99%. Multiply by unique confirmed battery inventory; bypass during balancing.
Dynamic-float cell trigger default: 3.450 V/cell, editable from the controller page.
